content_revisions_two_person.name: content_revisions_two_person
content_revisions_two_person.value: not ("content_revisions"."requires_second_person" and "content_revisions"."state" = 'approved' and "content_revisions"."approved_by" is not distinct from "content_revisions"."created_by")

categories_top_has_cover.name: categories_top_has_cover
categories_top_has_cover.value: "categories"."parent_id" is not null or "categories"."cover" is not null

review_evidence_has_target.name: review_evidence_has_target
review_evidence_has_target.value: "review_evidence"."url" is not null or "review_evidence"."media_asset_id" is not null

review_testing_text_present.name: review_testing_text_present
review_testing_text_present.value: length(btrim("review_testing"."tested_by")) > 0 and length(btrim("review_testing"."role")) > 0 and length(btrim("review_testing"."plan")) > 0 and length(btrim("review_testing"."region")) > 0 and length(btrim("review_testing"."conflicts")) > 0

affiliate_applications_submitted_dated.name: affiliate_applications_submitted_dated
affiliate_applications_submitted_dated.value: "affiliate_applications"."status" not in ('submitted', 'approved', 'rejected') or "affiliate_applications"."submitted_at" is not null

affiliate_applications_decided_dated.name: affiliate_applications_decided_dated
affiliate_applications_decided_dated.value: "affiliate_applications"."status" not in ('approved', 'rejected') or "affiliate_applications"."decided_at" is not null

tool_submissions_lengths.name: tool_submissions_lengths
tool_submissions_lengths.value: length(btrim("tool_submissions"."name")) between 2 and 120 and length("tool_submissions"."description") between 30 and 4000 and length("tool_submissions"."features") between 10 and 4000
